::: {#rem-capacity-meaning}
#### What capacity measures

$\mutinfof{X}{Y} = \entropyf{X} - \entropyf{X \mid Y}$
([mutual information as a reduction in entropy](entropy.qmd#thm-mutual-information-reduction))
is the uncertainty about the [input](#def-channel),
minus the uncertainty about the input left after seeing the output.
So $\mutinfof{X}{Y}$ is how much one output tells the receiver about the input,
on average,
and the [capacity](channel-capacity.qmd#def-channel-capacity) is that amount when the sender chooses
how often to send each input as well as possible.

:::
